title: Beyond dental applications: Why broader 3D printing insights matter
html:
Formnext

Tue. 17. November 2026

share save

FRANKFURT AM MAIN, Germany: Formnext 2026 kicks off today at Messe Frankfurt, bringing together the international additive manufacturing (AM) community until 20 November. AM has become an established production technology in the dental industry, and as adoption matures, the focus is shifting towards production efficiency, automation, quality and scalability. At the same time, rapid advances in technologies, materials, software and production approaches across the wider AM industry make it increasingly important for dental professionals to stay informed about developments beyond dental applications. This rapid pace of innovation is one reason Formnext has expanded beyond its annual exhibition to provide AM information year-round through its Industry Insights platform.

The expert knowledge platform covers market developments, practical use cases and technology trends from across the global AM landscape. Its content includes articles, white papers, expert interviews, technology updates and industry news, as well as webinars, videos and other educational resources.

By providing information in these different formats, Industry Insights allows professionals to engage with topics according to their interests and the needs of their day-to-day work. For dental professionals, the platform provides ongoing access to information that can support decision-making, highlight emerging trends and provide valuable perspectives on future developments in AM technologies and applications.

Formnext brings together users, technology providers and experts from across the additive manufacturing industry. (Image: Mesago Messe Frankfurt/Mathias Kutt)

Connecting industries and ideas

AM continues to benefit from the exchange of knowledge across industries. Many of the challenges facing the dental industry, including automation, process validation, digital workflow integration, material development and quality assurance, are also being addressed in other fields, and innovations developed in one industry can create opportunities in another.

Keeping pace with developments across the broader AM ecosystem can therefore help dental professionals identify emerging technologies, optimise existing workflows and explore opportunities for future growth. Industry Insights supports this exchange of knowledge by bringing together perspectives from users, technology providers, researchers and industry experts across different fields.

As AM continues to evolve, competitive advantage will increasingly depend not only on access to technology but also on access to knowledge. Those interested in keeping up with the latest trends, applications and innovations can explore Formnext’s Industry Insights platform and subscribe to the AM4U newsletter for regular updates, expert perspectives and valuable insights from across the global AM community.

More information can be found at the Formnext website.
